program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (has? p cells) (member? p cells))
    (define s1 (normalize-cells (find-color g 1)))
    (define s2 (normalize-cells (find-color g 2)))
    (define b1 (bbox-of-cells s1))
    (define b2 (bbox-of-cells s2))
    (define out-h (max (if b1 (+ 1 (third b1)) 0) (if b2 (+ 1 (third b2)) 0)))
    (define out-w (max (if b1 (+ 1 (fourth b1)) 0) (if b2 (+ 1 (fourth b2)) 0)))
    (define res (append (filter (lambda (p) (not (has? p s2))) s1)
                        (filter (lambda (p) (not (has? p s1))) s2)))
    (if (empty? res)
        (empty-grid 1 1 0)
        (paint-cells (empty-grid out-h out-w 0) res 8))))
